description.value: Yummy Slice Pizza is a Canadian-owned pizza-by-the-slice chain with numerous locations across the Lower Mainland, specializing in takeout and delivery. The Richmond Number 3 Road location sits in a busy commercial corridor and offers an unusually broad menu that spans classic North American pies through South Asian-inspired options like Tandoori Paneer and Yummy Potato. A catering program serving schools and corporate clients signals an established, high-volume operation well-suited to feeding hungry groups.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 17m; rack at 18m; rack at 44m; rack at 55m; lockers (secure) at 85m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Yummy Slice Pizza is an active Canadian-owned pizza takeout and delivery chain with the Richmond 6386 No 3 Rd location explicitly listed under their locations and contact page. The site confirms takeout and delivery, and the menu lists multiple clearly vegetarian pizzas (Veggie, Veggie Lovers, Yummy Paneer, Tandoori Paneer, etc.). No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling amenities.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or discoverable on the website (contact page uses a form only).
OSM unit number '110' is not reflected in the address field but is in addr:unit tag; worth verifying the unit on-site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible fast-food pizza business with a confirmed Richmond location and an operational website. A useful calorie stop for touring cyclists on Number 3 Road.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a dedicated vegetarian section with multiple options including Veggie, Veggie Lovers, Greek, Garden Pesto, Yummy Veggie, Yummy Potato, Yummy Paneer, Tandoori Paneer, and Creamy Corn. No explicit vegan or gluten-free claims found
